conventions.mos_residue_index: 1-based residue index of the MOS-sanitized copy: per chain, renumbered to entity-sequence order. This is the numbering used by the 3D viewer, SelectResidues/ManageAnnotation, and every MOS task that consumes the object.

result.statement: MOS did not renumber this import: for both chains label_seq_id, auth_seq_id and the MOS residue index are the same integer, with no insertion codes. MOS<->MMFold_1 residue mapping is therefore the identity function on both chains (A 1-118, B 1-128).

A.role: human PD-L1 (CD274) extracellular IgV-domain fragment construct, antigen

B.role: KN035 single-domain antibody (VHH), no light chain, binder
